Riding light (first light to last light, Vancouver): Wed, Nov 11 7:42am to 6:11pm; Thu, Nov 12 7:43am to 6:09pm; Fri, Nov 13 7:45am to 6:08pm. Hours outside that are dark and not listed; never suggest riding then.

Guillermo's own take for Wed, Nov 11 (his read, quote it as his, not yours): The southeast gale is slow to reach the south shore, with Boundary Bay almost calm this morning, but the easterly is pumping off West Van: Point Atkinson read E 22 gusting 29 at 7am, ahead of the page. Erwin Park should be working  from first light (about 7:45am) to about 5:30pm, E 17 to 21 and gusty, so bring a small wing. No tide or weed worries there. Check before driving: Point Atkinson 20 or more from the east, go. East Beach in White Rock is the backup if the southeast fills in later; the FT and Boundary should be good for kiting but weeds may still be there for foiling.

EC marine forecast, Howe Sound (issued 10:30 AM PCT 11 November 2026), WARNING IN EFFECT: Today Tonight and Thursday. Strong wind warning in effect. Wind northerly outflow 10 to 20 knots except southeast 25 over southern sections. Wind becoming southerly inflow 15 to 25 near noon then diminishing to light this evening.
